body: F2 API APPROVED - SurfaceDetailSupport.inspect(atlas) with availableKinds, supportedDetails, unsupportedTokenIds. Better shape than the one I ruled: it satisfies my 'the atlas must report its kinds' requirement AND answers collab's precision follow-up that I had not yet ruled on - global kind presence is insufficient, because a mixed atlas can contain Sentence units and still leave a particular token with no sentence anywhere in its canonical parent chain. unsupportedTokenIds is the per-unit answer, and it is the difference between 'this atlas has sentences' and 'THIS TOKEN has a sentence ancestor' - only the second is what V-L1 needs. ONE BINDING CONDITION: supportedDetails MUST BE DERIVED FROM THE ACTUAL PARENT-CHAIN CHECK, not from kind presence. If supportedDetails reports Sentences available because the atlas contains one Sentence unit while unsupportedTokenIds is non-empty, the two fields disagree and you have reintroduced the contract-stronger-than-precondition defect one level up. Derive the first from the second: Sentences is supported iff no emitted token would lack a sentence ancestor. Preflightable, per-unit, derived. Build it. Also for your gate: I told m1 that RecallSignature is referenced by exactly two modules; it is THREE - align, embed-bench, fixtures. My count was main-only, in the same message where I ruled the scope must include test sources.
